newsitem.title: USA: FiberMark Inc says orders soften slightly.
newsitem.headline: FiberMark Inc says orders soften slightly.

text.p: Fiber-based materials maker FiberMark Inc said on Thursday that orders had softened during the second fiscal quarter.
"Orders have softened slightly, commensurate with the moderate seasonal slowdown typically experienced early in the third quarter," the company said in a statement.
FiberMark added, "Pulp prices firmed slightly late in the second quarter, but we see no momentum for continued upward pressure."
The company posted 1997 second quarter earnings of $3.1 million, or $0.49 per share, compared with $1.8 million, or $0.30 per share, for the year-ago period.
The increase was attributed in part to stability in raw material costs.
